title: User Roles: Best Practices for Access Management
summary: Covers access management best practices for role assignment (Admin, Finance operational staff, Auditor), approval controls (Finance approval limited to approvals without additional authorization up to $50,000; dual approvals triggered at $25,000 for sensitive payments/high-impact changes), periodic access certifications, and monitoring/documentation for audit readiness.
faqs: Who should be granted Admin rights, and when should operational staff be placed in Finance?
What access should Auditors have to perform independent review without altering data or settings?
What are the Finance approval limits for transactions requiring approval without additional authorization (e.g., $50,000)?
At what threshold are dual approvals required for sensitive payments and high-impact changes (e.g., $25,000)?
How should recurring access certifications be performed and exceptions documented with management sign-off?
What monitoring and records are required for audit readiness (e.g., payment pattern changes, role/approval/policy change documentation)?
